definitions.gloss: logging; felling trees; cutting down trees
definitions.explanation: the act of cutting down trees, either for harvesting timber or clearing land

notes:
{伐採|ばっさい} means cutting down trees for timber harvesting or land clearing. A compound of {伐|ばつ} (fell, cut) + {採|さい} (harvest, gather).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{伐採|ばっさい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fell a tree
- ⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧{伐採|ばっさい}: illegal logging
- ⟦{森林|しんりん}→森林：01441_shinrin⟧{伐採|ばっさい}: deforestation
- {伐採|ばっさい}⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧: logging permit

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{植林|しょくりん}→植林：08436_shokurin⟧: afforestation (opposite concept)
- {皆伐|かいばつ}: clear-cutting
- {間伐|かんばつ}: thinning (selective cutting)

ENVIRONMENTAL CONTEXT:
⟦{違法|いほう}→違法：09687_ihou⟧{伐採|ばっさい} (illegal logging) is a major environmental issue, contributing to ⟦{地球|ちきゅう}{温暖化|おんだんか}→地球温暖化：18873_chikyuuondanka⟧ (global warming) and habitat loss. Often appears in news and environmental discussions.
